name: Nadya Valenmann de Lonval
source:
Mother of [url=/c173518]Aven[/url] and sister to [url=/c133729]Agust[/url]. After her sudden departure from Tuolovi she settled as a professor in Xenoanthropology at the university on Ryūjin Primem where she lives with her daughter.
